# Core v0.1.1 — 最小接續規則準備紀錄 / Minimal continuation preparation record

## 目的與範圍

[Issue #19](https://github.com/jeffery777/engineering-workflow-core/issues/19) 在 [Continue](../../contracts/workflow.md#wf-stages) 明寫：「優先沿用原 Session；若中斷點有結果不明的操作或委派工作，先確認其現況，再接續未完成部分。」並提供對應英文導讀。這是既有接續順序、ownership 與未知效果查證義務的文件澄清，採 patch `v0.1.1`；「優先」為偏好，不要求硬性還原。原授權、停止、手動 checkpoint fallback、獨立 review 及必要 gates 保留。

本包修改 `contracts/workflow.md`、`README.md`、`CHANGELOG.md`、`docs/provenance/source-map.md`，新增本檔。其餘九個既有檔案 bytes／mode、原 107 單位、完整 notices／LICENSE、v0.1.0 條目及準備紀錄保留。比較基線為 `174df2af8dedf813b9bd4e3c184a627ee87d3cd8`，不是本版最終 pin。這份點時準備紀錄不證明本版已合併、發布、採用或安裝；目前工作停在 draft PR 與 readiness 回報。

Core 仍是純 Markdown 共用契約。不新增程式、skill、validator、installer、catalog、VERSION、schema、runtime API、Reason／Orca 整合、恢復框架或強制五點稽核。不宣稱 Session 還原、跨工具去重、原生故障恢復、模型／接口遵循或兩端行為等價。

## 清冊、版本與採用條件

預期完整清冊由 13 檔增為 14 檔：13 份 Markdown 與原 LICENSE。完整路徑包含 README、CHANGELOG、四份 contracts、三份架構文件、source-map、upstream-notices、v0.1.0 與 v0.1.1 準備紀錄及 LICENSE；具體路徑沿用 [v0.1.0 清冊](v0.1.0.md)，再加 `docs/releases/v0.1.1.md`。

最終合併後，於新 annotated tag annotation、GitHub 正式 Release 及交接證據核對完整 commit、逐檔 raw SHA-256／bytes／Git mode，以及完整 14 檔與完整 13 份 Markdown 的兩個集合 digest。算法為 `sha256-path-tab-sha256-lf-v1`：按 UTF-8 path bytes 排序，串接 `path<TAB>raw-file-sha256<LF>` 後取 SHA-256。檔案大小及 mode 另列；來源壓縮檔的 digest 不等同文件集合 digest。本檔不內嵌自身最終 commit 或 digest；比較基線與舊集合 digest 不能代替新版身分。

Core 與 consumer 各自管理版本，Core 不需獨立安裝。待 Core 正式發行及固定身分讀回後，再分包處理 Codex 0.35.1、Grok 0.2.2 的建議版本；發行前重查版本可用性。各 consumer 核對 tag object 及解析後完整 immutable commit，更新 vendor／lock、逐檔及集合 digest、來源、allowlist、完整相對引用 dependency closure、notices、組裝及遵循驗證。Runtime 使用固定組裝文件，不追蹤 Core `main` 或動態 tag。Core 發行不自動更新 consumer；兩端 release、安裝及 Space 同步由協調者依各自授權與證據續行，本 Core 包不先改接口或安裝。

## 驗收與交付界線

- 核對真實 Issue／DoD、遠端 Issue-ID 分支、Git 身分與唯一 writer，完成上述五檔差異、14 檔清冊、九檔保護、107 單位與 v0.1.0 歷史、notices、雙語主要資訊、links／anchors、LF／whitespace 及本地靜態呈現驗證；呈現限制另記當次證據。
- 依實際差異評估公開契約風險，及早做獨立深入設計／安全分析，再審實作候選。安全掃描適用性須有 scope 與理由；Markdown 不構成通用豁免，不適用或未執行都不能記成掃描 Passed。
- 適用 commit gates 通過後才 commit、push 及建立 draft PR。對當前完整 base-to-head 另做新的獨立 exact-head review，核對必要 checks／CI、provider enforcement 與授權；head 改變須重新完整審查。準備紀錄不代替實際命令、findings、dispositions 與結果。
- 目前停止於 draft PR 與 merge／release readiness 回報。後續合併、tag、Release、consumer 更新及安裝仍須各自核對有效授權、前置及實際讀回；本記錄不自行授權操作。正式 publication 前另核未占用版本、精確 repo／tagger／新 annotated tag／最終 commit／雙語 Release body／manifest；不覆寫既有 tag，不盲重做結果不明的操作。

本包不部署、不改既有技能或全域設定、不啟用 memory／hooks／schedulers，也不操作公司系統或 EdgeInstaller。完整 ASD-STE100 規則及受控詞典符合性未驗證；依其原則編寫，不記為 Passed。正式契約以繁中為權威，英文提供等價主要資訊。保留 [MIT LICENSE](../../LICENSE)、[完整上游 notices](../provenance/upstream-notices.md)、[來源與改寫記錄](../provenance/source-map.md#task-continuation-update) 及 [CHANGELOG](../../CHANGELOG.md)；分發 substantial portions 須保留完整 copyright、permission 與 warranty notices，不能以連結代替。

## Purpose and scope

[Issue #19](https://github.com/jeffery777/engineering-workflow-core/issues/19) states in [Continue](../../contracts/workflow.md#wf-stages) that the original session is preferred. If an operation or delegated task has an unknown outcome at the interruption point, check its current state before continuing unfinished work. It adds equivalent English guidance. Patch `v0.1.1` clarifies existing continuation order, ownership, and unknown-effect checks. “Prefer” is a preference; it does not require forced restoration. Existing authority, stops, manual checkpoint fallback, independent review, and required gates remain.

This packet changes `contracts/workflow.md`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, and `docs/provenance/source-map.md`, and adds this file. Preserve the other nine existing files' bytes and modes, original 107 units, complete notices and LICENSE, and v0.1.0 entries and preparation record. The comparison base is `174df2af8dedf813b9bd4e3c184a627ee87d3cd8`. It is not this version's final pin. This point-in-time record does not prove merge, publication, adoption, or installation. Current work stops at a draft PR and readiness report.

Core remains a shared Markdown contract. Add no code, skill, validator, installer, catalog, VERSION, schema, runtime API, Reason or Orca integration, recovery framework, or mandatory five-point audit. Make no claim of session restoration, cross-tool deduplication, native fault recovery, model/interface conformance, or equivalent behavior across interfaces.

## Inventory, versions, and adoption conditions

The expected full inventory grows from 13 to 14 files: 13 Markdown files and the original LICENSE. Paths include README, CHANGELOG, four contracts, three architecture documents, source-map, upstream-notices, v0.1.0 and v0.1.1 preparation records, and LICENSE. Use the [v0.1.0 inventory](v0.1.0.md) plus `docs/releases/v0.1.1.md` for the exact paths.

After the final merge, verify the full commit, per-file raw SHA-256, bytes and Git mode, and separate digests for all 14 files and all 13 Markdown files in the new annotated tag annotation, formal GitHub Release, and handoff evidence. Use `sha256-path-tab-sha256-lf-v1`: sort by UTF-8 path bytes, concatenate `path<TAB>raw-file-sha256<LF>`, then calculate SHA-256. Record sizes and modes separately. A source archive digest differs from the document-set digest. Do not embed this file's own final commit or digest. Neither the comparison base nor an old set digest identifies the new version.

Core and consumers manage separate versions. Users do not install Core separately. After formal Core publication and fixed-identity readback, handle proposed Codex 0.35.1 and Grok 0.2.2 versions in separate packets. Recheck version availability before publication. Each consumer verifies the tag object and full resolved immutable commit, then updates vendor files, lock, per-file and set digests, sources, allowlist, complete relative-reference dependency closure, notices, assembly, and conformance checks. Runtime uses fixed assembled documents. It must not follow Core `main` or a dynamic tag. Core publication does not update consumers automatically. The coordinator handles later consumer releases, installation, and Space synchronization under their own authority and evidence. This Core packet does not change interfaces or installations in advance.

## Acceptance and delivery boundary

- Verify the real Issue and DoD, remote Issue-ID branch, Git identity, and sole writer. Check the five-file diff, 14-file inventory, nine protected files, original 107 units and v0.1.0 history, notices, equivalent main information in both languages, links, anchors, LF, whitespace, and local static rendering. Record rendering limits in current evidence.
- Assess public-contract risk from the actual diff. Perform early independent deep design and security analysis, then review the implementation candidate. State scope and reasons for security-scan applicability. Markdown is not a blanket exemption. An inapplicable or unexecuted scan is not scan Passed.
- Commit, push, and create a draft PR only after applicable commit gates pass. Perform a new independent complete base-to-head exact-head review. Check required checks and CI, provider enforcement, and authority. A changed head needs a new complete review. Preparation records do not replace actual commands, findings, dispositions, and results.
- Current work stops at a draft PR and merge/release readiness report. Later merge, tag, Release, consumer updates, and installation each require valid authority, prerequisites, and actual readback. This record grants no operation authority. Before formal publication, verify the unused version, exact repository, tagger, new annotated tag, final commit, bilingual Release body, and manifest. Do not overwrite existing tags or blindly repeat operations with unknown outcomes.

This packet does not deploy, change installed skills or global settings, enable memory, hooks or schedulers, or operate company systems or EdgeInstaller. Full ASD-STE100 rules and controlled-dictionary conformance have not been verified. Write using its principles; do not record full conformance as Passed. Traditional Chinese is authoritative for formal contracts. English provides equivalent main information. Retain the [MIT LICENSE](../../LICENSE), [complete upstream notices](../provenance/upstream-notices.md), [source and change history](../provenance/source-map.md#task-continuation-update), and [CHANGELOG](../../CHANGELOG.md). Distribution of substantial portions must retain complete copyright, permission, and warranty notices. Links do not replace them.
